errors.quote: Since $t_i\ge r/2$, at most $2dT/r$ lines occur, so polynomial setup per line is $o(Tp)$.
errors.problem: Stated without its hypothesis. The paper's bound O(dTp^c/r)=o(Tp) needs r to grow faster than every polynomial in p and d to be polynomially bounded in p, so that O(dp^{c-1}/r)->0. Also, it is the total setup over all lines, not the setup per line, that is o(Tp).
